typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		CCYCD as string,
		CCYALPHANUM as string,
		CCYCDDESC as string,
		COUNTRY as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSourcep021ispprod
OLEDBSourcep021ispprod derive(loadDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> GetCurrentdate
GetCurrentdate derive({Copy of CCYALPHANUM} = CCYALPHANUM,
		{Copy of COUNTRY} = COUNTRY,
		{Copy of CCYCD} = CCYCD,
		{Copy of CCYCDDESC} = CCYCDDESC,
		{Copy of loadDate} = loadDate) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		LoadDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		COUNTRY as string,
		CCYCD as string,
		CCYALPHANUM as string,
		CCYCDDESC as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		LoadDate = {Copy of loadDate},
		COUNTRY = {Copy of COUNTRY},
		CCYCD = {Copy of CCYCD},
		CCYALPHANUM = {Copy of CCYALPHANUM},
		CCYCDDESC = {Copy of CCYCDDESC}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
